findings.evidence: `grep -rn 'netCharge_chargedLegs' code/` returns only ChargedLegs.lean:31 (the docstring). L122 `def chargedLegs` is the sole declaration in that namespace.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem DisKinematics.netCharge_chargedLegs (K : DisKinematics V) (eLepton eHadron : ℝ) : netCharge (K.chargedLegs eLepton eHadron) = 0`, provable from `netCharge_sumElim` and `netCharge_chargedLine`.
findings.issue: The module docstring lists `DisKinematics.netCharge_chargedLegs` under "Main statements", but no such declaration exists; the `DisKinematics` namespace (L115-125) contains only the `chargedLegs` def.

findings.evidence: ChargedLegs.lean:105/108 give `chargedLine` the parallel `@[simp] chargedLine_zero`/`chargedLine_one`; `chargedLegs` at L122 gets nothing. Eikonal.lean:156 `rw [chargedLegs, …]` unfolds the definition rather than rewriting by a lemma.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem chargedLegs_eq_sumElim (K : DisKinematics V) (eLepton eHadron : ℝ) : K.chargedLegs eLepton eHadron = Sum.elim (chargedLine K.k K.kPrime eLepton) (chargedLine K.p K.pPrime eHadron) := (rfl)` and use it in place of `rw [chargedLegs]`.
findings.issue: `chargedLegs` has no `_def`/characteristic lemma, so neither `@[simp] netCharge_sumElim` (L96) nor `@[simp] eikonalCurrent_sumElim` (Eikonal.lean:119) fires on it; the only consumer has to unfold the body by hand (`rw [chargedLegs, …]`, Eikonal.lean:156), which works only because the file exposes bodies.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn 'eikonalCurrent_chargedLegs' code/` matches only `eikonalCurrent_chargedLegs_conserved` (Eikonal.lean:50, 152). roadmap/EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/RadiativeCorrections/README.md:443-444 names the current itself alongside the conservation check.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem eikonalCurrent_chargedLegs (g : Bilin V) (K : DisKinematics V) (eLepton eHadron ℓ) : eikonalCurrent g (K.chargedLegs eLepton eHadron) ℓ = eLepton • ((g K.kPrime ℓ)⁻¹ • K.kPrime - (g K.k ℓ)⁻¹ • K.k) + eHadron • ((g K.pPrime ℓ)⁻¹ • K.pPrime - (g K.p ℓ)⁻¹ • K.p)`, which follows from `eikonalCurrent_sumElim` and `eikonalCurrent_chargedLine` once the lemma in the previous finding exists.
findings.issue: The explicit eikonal current of lepton–hadron scattering is missing: the PR description lists `eikonalCurrent_chargedLegs` ("lepton current plus hadron current") as a deliverable and RadiativeCorrections README.md:443 asks for "the eikonal current for elastic lepton-proton scattering with four charged legs", but only the contracted `eikonalCurrent_chargedLegs_conserved` is shipped. A consumer building the YFS exponent from `apply_eikonalCurrent_eikonalCurrent` cannot evaluate `J` on `chargedLegs` without unfolding.

summary: No compatibility artifacts and the simp annotations flagged last round are fixed, but `DisKinematics.chargedLegs` ships with no characteristic lemma at all: two declarations advertised in the module docstring and PR description (`netCharge_chargedLegs`, `eikonalCurrent_chargedLegs`) do not exist, and nothing reduces `chargedLegs`, so the `@[simp]` `*_sumElim` lemmas are dead on the only concrete process in the repo.
